The issuer-specific relationship and exclusivity are supported by the official 2024 report, with a 2026 presentation transcript providing more recent industry-level corroboration; no further research was needed for candidate review.

The issuer’s official 2024 report directly supports the company-specific exclusive-sourcing statement for 2024, but does not by itself establish that the arrangement remained unchanged after that period.
The 2026 conference’s industry-wide slide text was available as a third-party transcript; the issuer’s official page confirms and links the presentation, but its PDF timed out when opened.
